(EGY-16). Exercise 8. a) He practiced for a presentation: tomorrow he has an online meeting with the Cairo office. In Egyptian, but an Egyptian is respectable (cultivated). Words Change (malāmiḥ instead of "Com' is "M'); remains the Egyptian grammar (haʿraḍ, ḥaḍratkum, in-nahārda). Objective; cost and duration; challenges. He won't use ya sīdi and laʾ w- ēh (from podcasts and evenings between friends); will use zayy but ḥaḍratkum šayfīn e min nāḥya... wi min nāḥya Tanya. b) That you don't need to study the Egyptian, because the fuṣḥā is the language of all Arabs. Thanking, defining the important question and agreeing in part (the fuṣḥā It is essential). Because it's not enough to talk to people or understand a movie: at coffee there fuṣḥā It would sound like a historical series. The speed and the lines. Two sides of the same coin. c) The work from home in your company. Advantages, problems, proposals. Transport time, up to two hours a day in Cairo; productivity increased by approximately 10%. Some colleagues feel isolated; The online meetings have become too many. A mixed system: two days in the office and three days from home.
